csv_scope_of_work: The City of Mount Pleasant is seeking to contract with a competent, qualified Engineering firm, registered to practice in the State of Texas, that has had experience in the following areas: o Registered and in good standing as a professional engineering per the Texas Engineering Practice Act; o Municipal transportation engineering, including the planning, design, and construction administration of roadway, sidewalk, drainage, traffic control, and utility improvement projects; o Experience providing engineering services for projects within the City of Mount Pleasant or comparable Texas municipalities; o Experience working on TXDOT-funded projects; o Experience preparing and coordinating environmental documentation in compliance with the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA), including coordination with TxDOT and the Federal Highway Administration (FHWA), as applicable;
